dhp100:1: Though there are a thousand sayings
dhp100:4: hearing which one is brought to peace.
dhp101:1: Though there are a thousand verses
dhp101:3: better is one word of a verse
dhp101:4: hearing which one is brought to peace.
dhp102:1: One may speak a hundred verses
dhp102:3: better is one verse of Dhamma,
dhp102:4: hearing which one is brought to peace.
dhp103:1: One may conquer a thousand men a thousand times in a battle,
dhp103:3: but having conquered one’s own self,
dhp103:4: one would surely be supreme in battle.
dhp104:3: for the person who conquers himself,
dhp105:4: for a person who is like this.
dhp106:1: One might give alms impartially with a thousand (coins of money) month by month for a hundred (years);
dhp106:3: and one might worship someone with developed self for a second –
dhp107:1: One person might care for the fire in the woods for a hundred years;
dhp107:3: and one might worship someone with developed self for a second –
dhp108:1: Whatever the alms or the sacrifice in the world
dhp108:2: the one seeking merit may give for a year,
dhp108:3: all that comes not to a quarter (of the merit) –
dhp108:4: better is the worship of the upright.
dhp109:1: For the one who is constantly worshipping honourable elders,
dhp109:3: four things increase: the length of life,
dhp110:1: One might live for a hundred years,
dhp110:3: (but) a life of one day is better,
dhp110:4: for one with virtue and meditation.
dhp111:1: One might live for a hundred years,
dhp111:3: (but) a life of one day is better,
dhp111:4: for one endowed with wisdom and meditation.
dhp112:1: One might live for a hundred years,
dhp112:3: (but) a life of one day is better,
dhp112:4: for one with energy set up and firm.
dhp113:1: One might live for a hundred years
dhp113:3: (but) a life of one day is better
dhp113:4: (for the one) seeing rise and fall.
dhp114:1: One might live for a hundred years
dhp114:3: (but) a life of one day is better
dhp115:1: One might live for a hundred years
dhp115:3: (but) a life of one day is better
